ConflictTransformationRecord.description: A coordination system's declaration of its conflict-transformation capacity across the five invariants, the scales it addresses, and its adoption tier.

adoption_tier.description: Section 8. The adoption tier the record supports.

conformance.description: The per-invariant conformance answers on the face; no total.

constitutional_precondition_established.description: Section 4. Whether parties share sufficient foundational vocabulary about what the organization is to name what they are in conflict about; if not, the required first engagement is constitutional dialogue, not conflict transformation.

invariants.description: Section 4. The five structural invariants, each rendered as a typed object carrying its satisfaction status and epistemic tier. They are constitutive of a capacity declaration; a record that names no invariants could claim capacity while assessing nothing.

scales_addressed.description: Section 5. The operational scales at which the record declares the invariants apply.

subject.description: The coordination system whose conflict-transformation capacity is declared.

ConflictTransformationRecord.title: ConflictTransformationRecord

ConformanceAnswer.description: Per-invariant answer; silence is not one of the values.
ConformanceAnswer.title: ConformanceAnswer

ConformanceDeclaration.description: The per-invariant conformance answers. There is deliberately no overall or total field: conformance is per-invariant, mirroring the suite's refusal to collapse a profile into a single number.
ConformanceDeclaration.title: ConformanceDeclaration

SatisfactionStatus.description: The status of a structural invariant against the system; silence is not one of the values.
SatisfactionStatus.title: SatisfactionStatus

StructuralInvariant.description: Section 4. One of the five structural invariants, individuated by its satisfaction test and its epistemic tier, not by a label. An invariant with no satisfaction test is a name, so satisfaction_test, satisfaction_status, and epistemic_tier are required.

epistemic_tier.description: Section 4. The invariant's epistemic tier (A structural, B literature-plus-structural, C measurement-calibration).

id.description: The invariant handle (for example legibility, graduated_engagement, proactive_disposition, capacity_provision, recognition).

satisfaction_test.description: The structural test that determines whether the invariant is satisfied, stated so an independent observer can apply it.

signature.description: The observed violation or satisfaction signature supporting the status; some signatures are computable from the coordination record.
